## Liqi Shu, MD

Vascular Neurologist · [UPMC Stroke Institute](https://providers.upmc.com/provider/liqi-shu/4838362)  
Core Faculty · [Pitt Cerebrovascular Medicine](https://www.neurology.pitt.edu/clinical-divisions/cerebrovascular-medicine)  
Adjunct Instructor in Neurology · [Brown University](https://vivo.brown.edu/display/lshu)

Dr. Shu is a vascular neurologist with training in neurointervention, computer science, and clinical research. He develops practical approaches to stroke-risk prediction, clinical-data extraction, and recovery measurement using real-world data, registries, imaging, physiologic signals, and wearable sensors. He completed neurology residency and vascular neurology fellowship at Brown and an NIH StrokeNet SPIRIT research fellowship.

[Email](mailto:shul@pitt.edu) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uFmbVxEAAAAJ&hl=en) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9784-8475)
:::
